seo.title: Terms & Conditions - Kibay Espumante
seo.description: Terms and conditions for using the Kibay Espumante website and purchasing our premium sparkling wines.

title: Terms & Conditions
intro: Please read these terms carefully before using our website or purchasing our products. By accessing or using any part of the site, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.

sections.title: 1. Legal Drinking Age Requirement
sections.content: You must be of legal drinking age in your jurisdiction to visit this site and purchase alcohol. By using this website, you affirm that you are at least 18 years old (or the legal drinking age in your country of residence). We reserve the right to ask for valid identification upon delivery.

sections.title: 2. Online Sales & Availability
sections.content: All products listed on our website are subject to availability. We reserve the right to limit the quantity of products we supply, supply only part of an order, or divide up orders. We also reserve the right to alter the terms or duration of any special offers or sale promotions.

sections.title: 3. Pricing and Payments
sections.content: Prices may be displayed in Dominican Pesos (DOP) or US Dollars (USD) for browsing convenience, but all charges are processed exclusively in Dominican Pesos (DOP) through the CARDNET payment gateway. If your card is issued in another currency, your issuing bank performs the currency conversion at the rate in effect at the time, which may include additional fees outside of our control. We accept major Visa and Mastercard credit and debit cards, with 3D Secure authentication when required by the issuing bank. Prices are subject to change without notice. Payment must be received in full prior to acceptance of an order.

sections.title: 4. Order Confirmation & Acceptance
sections.content: Receipt of an electronic order confirmation does not signify our acceptance of your order, nor does it constitute confirmation of our offer to sell. We reserve the right at any time after receipt of your order to accept or decline your order for any reason.

sections.title: 5. Shipping & Delivery of Alcohol
sections.content: Alcohol shipping regulations are complex. We currently ship only to specific regions within the Dominican Republic. An adult signature (18+) with valid ID is required upon delivery. Packages cannot be left at the door without a signature.

sections.title: 6. Returns, Cancellations & Refunds
sections.content: Due to the nature of our products, we generally do not accept returns on alcohol unless the product is damaged or spoiled. Please refer to our Shipping & Returns Policy for detailed information on how to handle damaged shipments or request cancellations.

sections.title: 7. Responsible Consumption Disclaimer
sections.content: Kibay Espumante promotes responsible drinking. Alcohol should be consumed in moderation. Excessive consumption of alcohol may be harmful to your health. We do not support underage drinking, excessive drinking, or drinking and driving.

sections.title: 8. Intellectual Property

sections.title: 9. Cookies & Data Use
sections.content: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience and analyze our traffic. By using our website, you consent to our use of cookies in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

sections.content: The materials on Kibay Espumante's website are provided on an 'as is' basis. We make no warranties, expressed or implied, and hereby disclaim and negate all other warranties including, without limitation, implied warranties or conditions of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, or non-infringement of intellectual property.
